LanguageData.RP_ToggleCoverageDark: Shaded blue - dark, with a ground glow under 0.3 (at night, in a blackout, or an unlit corner), in a free-time zone (corridors are not drawn, but the same holds in them), not in a cell. A guard on foot sees only 3 cells there and a camera nothing, whatever the colour says is close; a manned tower's searchlight still sees all of its range. A lamp lights it again. Dusk can show up to about a quarter of a minute late.
LanguageData.RP_DangerRowUnlit: {0} ({1}). Most of the patch is dark now - a guard sees only 3 cells there and a camera nothing, so light it as well as posting a guard.
